terminals.name: gateway
terminals.description: mcp-flow MCP gateway (serve). Generates ephemeral MCP_FLOW_MASTER_KEY / MCP_FLOW_ADMIN_TOKEN when they are not provided as secrets. Health: http://127.0.0.1:8787/health · MCP: /mcp · Admin UI: /admin/
terminals.command: export MCP_FLOW_MASTER_KEY="${MCP_FLOW_MASTER_KEY:-$(openssl rand -base64 32)}"; export MCP_FLOW_ADMIN_TOKEN="${MCP_FLOW_ADMIN_TOKEN:-$(openssl rand -hex 32)}"; export MCP_FLOW_HOST="${MCP_FLOW_HOST:-0.0.0.0}"; npm run dev -- --port 8787
